name: ProductReviews
description: Mortar product reviews: average rating, an accessible star distribution and individual reviews, optionally with each reviewer's avatar.

props.title: string
props.reviews: Review[] ({ id: string; author: string; rating: number; date: string; title: string; body: ReactNode; avatar?: string (photo URL used with avatars) })
props.avatars: boolean (shows each reviewer's Avatar, their photo or initials, beside their name)
props.headingLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 (default 2; review titles are one level below)

contract.usage: Import { ProductReviews } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
